name: Verifed V14.3
description: Added 37 individually matched food-image references across Fresh Kitchen, Reyes Mezcaleria, Monroe, Strand, Osprey, Stubborn Mule, Lazy Moon, Pig Floyds and Woodlands. 29 sources are from Fresh Kitchen's official menu; remaining sources describe specific named restaurant dishes. Per-item image coverage grows from 267 to 304 of 1,630 active menu entries, without repeating generic venue photography or changing food safety assessment. GitHub-only update; no new Expo Snack publish.
verification: Image registry and menu catalog are tested to map exact item keys and preserve absence of unrelated default photos.
Fresh Kitchen photo assets are provided as AVIF and may require device-specific support; app falls back when remote images fail.
All 25 restaurants retain venue-level header imagery, but some have no verified individual food photo yet.
No image establishes allergen safety or location availability; third-party commercial image reuse may require permission.
